comparisons.peer_summary: Qualcomm Systems Innovations (QSI) makes strategic investments primarily through Qualcomm Ventures in early-stage companies across industries such as 5G, AI, automotive, consumer, enterprise, cloud, IoT, and XR, aiming to expand opportunities for Qualcomm's technologies and support new product introductions. These investments consist mainly of non-marketable equity securities, with a general intent to pursue exit strategies.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and Qualcomm disclose risks associated with their non-marketable equity strategic investments. Intel explicitly states that financial market volatility negatively affects the prospects of portfolio companies and the likelihood of realizing value, noting these investments involve significant risk with no assurance of success. Similarly, Qualcomm identifies its QSI segment as making strategic investments primarily through non-marketable equity securities in early-stage companies, with an intent to pursue exit strategies. While Intel focuses on the general market risk and potential for total or partial loss, Qualcomm highlights the strategic purpose (expanding technology opportunities) and the specific vehicle (Qualcomm Ventures) for these non-marketable equity holdings.

sentences.text: Many of the same factors that could result in an adverse movement of equity market prices affect our non-marketable equity investments, although we cannot always quantify the impacts directly.

These types of investments involve a great deal of risk, and there can be no assurance that any specific company will grow or become successful; consequently, we could lose all or part of our investment.
Our non-marketable equity securities had a carrying amount of $4.5 billion as of December 28, 2024 ($4.6 billion as of December 30, 2023).

QSI makes strategic investments primarily through our Qualcomm Ventures arm that are focused on expanding or opening new opportunities for our technologies as well as supporting the design and introduction of new products and services (or enhancing existing products or services).
Investments primarily include non-marketable equity securities and, to a lesser extent, marketable equity securities and convertible debt instruments.
As part of our strategic investment activities, we generally intend to pursue various exit strategies for each of our QSI investments in the foreseeable future.
